status: Post-primary exploratory audit, specified after first external policy results; never rewrites primary scores or hyperparameters
matching: Exact normalized subject, question and ordered choices; ambiguous gold and unmatched rows excluded only from secondary audit with counts
regrading: Strict response-only prefix parser against independent benchmark answer; same frozen primary actions; no gold passed to policy
shift: Freeze zero-shot policies and development choices; join five-shot only to zero-shot held-out target sample identifiers; use original group assignment
caveat: Few-shot demonstration overlap not audited; cross-shot test is target-held-out, not a claim that all demonstrations are held out
